scope: Independent source review and isolated tests. No real credentials, target Git access, target scan, or network.
reviewedBehavior: Requires seven configured app values and two operator values. Canonical Steam key coverage comes from the independently reviewed helper.
Uses read-only exact-blob and Git-state helpers. The output path is outside the repository.
Missing and invalid helpers return a fixed error. Error details do not enter output.
Exclusive output creation preserves files and symlink targets created during the scan.
limitations: This wrapper scans only known values in raw blobs. Gitleaks and expanded compressed payload checks are separate.
